replace.find: And it was true, and if you had been there you would have seen his men go out. They rode through the land with sacks and gold, buying every echo from every cliff and well and valley. From the red cliffs they bought the morning answer. From the deep wells they bought the cool reply. From the low valley they bought the evening call. They paid the villages and sealed each echo in a clay jar and set the jars in the treasury row upon row. The cliffs fell silent as closed doors. That was how the silence came.
replace.with: And it was true, once. Now no cliff had a mouth and no well had an ear. The echoes stood in the treasury row upon row, and the king had what he had paid for.
